caption: The video depicts a bearded man wearing round glasses and a red-and-blue plaid shirt seated behind an open laptop, seen through a pane of glass in a dim interior. A warm tripod lamp glows at the left, a dark window frame stands behind him, and out-of-focus lights scatter across the right side. White rectangular screen reflections sit in his lenses throughout, while a soft vertical haze crosses the left side of his head. A faint ghosted duplicate of his face is briefly visible on the right, then diffuses away as the reflected light changes. A bright out-of-focus blob over the laptop lid shifts from a small dot into a diagonal glowing streak before drifting across the lower center and gradually dimming. The man's head tilts slightly downward toward the screen as the background elements drift slowly within the frame.
